# Generate Python Barrel
[API index](index.md) | [Definition schema](schema.md)
| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `stdlib.python.barrel.task` |
| Source | `02_core/runtimes/yaml/definitions/stdlib.python.yaml` |
| Tags | python, generator |
Scans `package_dir` for direct sibling modules and subpackages, then
renders their public surface into `<package_dir>/__init__.py` via
`stdlib.python.barrel.template`. Honors `mode: check` so CI can detect
drift the same way the docs workflow does.
Modules declaring an `__all__` are treated as the source of truth.
Modules without `__all__` fall back to every top-level non-underscore
`class`/`def`/assignment — the standard Python "public-by-default"
convention. Modules with neither pattern (empty inferred surface) are
dropped.

## Declared API

### Inputs
| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `package_dir` | `string` | yes | `-` | Absolute path to the Python package whose barrel to regenerate. |
| `package_doc` | `string` | no | `` | Optional one-line docstring summary placed at the top of __init__.py. |
| `mode` | `string` | no | `write` | Either `write` to regenerate output or `check` to assert it's current. |
| `exclude` | `array` | no | `[]` | Module names to skip — typically CLI entry points or scripts that
live in the package dir but aren't part of its public API.
 |
| `flatten` | `boolean` | no | `True` | Forwarded to the template. `true` re-exports every symbol from every
child; `false` exposes children as namespaces. See the template's own
docs for when each is appropriate.
 |
| `yaml_analysis_src` | `string` | no | `{{ runtime.workflow_dir }}/src` | Directory containing the `python_packages` module. Defaults to the
workflow's own `src/` so this definition bootstraps from inside this
bucket; override when generating barrels for an unrelated package.
 |

### Run Operations
#### Scan package and stash module list
_No operation description provided._
```python
import json
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, "{{ yaml_analysis_src }}")
from python_packages import scan_package
exclude = {{ exclude | tojson }}
modules = scan_package(Path("{{ package_dir }}"), exclude=exclude)
package_name = os.path.basename(os.path.abspath("{{ package_dir }}")) or "package"
state_file = os.environ["STATE_FILE"]
with open(state_file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    json.dump({"barrel_modules": modules, "barrel_package_name": package_name}, fh)

```
#### Render __init__.py
_No operation description provided._
```render
render:
  definition: stdlib.python.barrel.template
  arguments:
    package_name: '{{ barrel_package_name }}'
    package_doc: '{{ package_doc }}'
    modules: '{{ barrel_modules }}'
    flatten: '{{ flatten }}'
  target_path: '{{ package_dir }}/__init__.py'
  mode: '{{ mode }}'
```
